title: neoporteria recondita var. residua
intro: Neoporteria recondita var. residua, commonly known as Residua, is a rare and lesser-known cactus species in the Echinocereus genus. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Residua are primarily attributed to its ability to stimulate blood circulation, reduce pain, and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of Residua include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
